- Key Verified Facts:

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To solve limitations in tactile feedback and motor precision, and to study neuroplasticity in prosthetic integration
* [Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Closed-loop prosthetic technology based on implanted neural electrodes.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Focus shifting to neuroplasticity and the synergy between sensory feedback and motor control.

### Foreign Funds on Pace for Record Taiwan Stock Exodus in AI Rout
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/17ec84dc8a3acd0f

### A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light
- Canonical URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/a26cf44b964a3311
- Primary Source: Wired AI (https://www.wired.com/story/a-new-breed-of-chip-runs-ai-models-using-waves-of-light/)
- Executive Summary: German startup Q.ANT is deploying photonic processors that use light waves instead of electrons to minimize heat generation and energy consumption. Designed as a coprocessor to handle nonlinear calculations alongside GPUs, the technology is currently undergoing pilot programs at IONOS data centers with over 30 engineering teams developing optimized models.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Q.ANT (German startup) and Founder/CEO Michael Förtsch; cloud provider IONOS: Implementing photonic processors as coprocessors for non-linear calculations to reduce power-to-performance costs
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To address skyrocketing energy costs and thermal constraints in high-density AI data centers
* [Key Technical Spec] Rising energy costs in AI data centers drive demand for photonic alternatives.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Q.ANT has initiated pilot programs with IONOS and is actively building an AI software ecosystem.
